newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds rallied on, pushing the March Confederate Bond futures contract, or "Conf," to a new contract high of 117.77 during the session.
"The market was looking for paper, especially longer maturities," one trader said.

He said some investors were desperate to buy, but the supply was seen as relatively thin. Demand may have been tied to a strong need for cash bonds which can be used to deliver against the Conf contract.
This may have been a factor boosting Conf prices sharply, while Bunds gained only slightly and U.S. T-bonds declined.
There was strong demand for the outstanding 4-1/2 percent June 2007 bond which was reopened in this week's tender.
Results of the auction will be published around 1200 GMT. -- Wednesday's closing prices as follows:
March Comi medium-term bond up 30 at 111.60
Mar Euro Swiss francs up four at 98.20.
